eligibility_rule_limitation: Inventory code itself checks complete status, protocol string and encoding fix flag. Actual row IDs were checked independently for every eligible OOF table; fingerprints were independently verified where recorded. A v3 name alone does not prove exact fold lineage.
evidence_limitation: OOF files do not store individual fold IDs. Exact source-ID sets and recorded fingerprints/row counts match independently rebuilt group folds; earlier source reviews establish how fold predictions are generated. This check does not infer hidden training operations from probabilities.
ongoing_worker_caveat: Counts are a snapshot. Running/failed/interrupted cases were excluded; new records completed after snapshot need equivalent checks before the final freeze.
